_comment: Every photograph on this site is a real photograph of Maharashtra, taken from
Wikimedia Commons under a licence that allows reuse. `file` is the exact Commons
file name, which is how the credit, the licence and the photographer are looked
up at fetch time — nothing here is typed by hand, so a credit cannot drift away
from the picture it belongs to.
`where` is the real place in the frame. The demo farms are invented; their
landscapes are not, and the credit line on each photo says where it was taken so
a visitor is never told that a picture of Vengurla is a picture of Pawas.
Roles: `wide` gets encoded up to 1920px for full-bleed use, `card` up to 960px.
Run `npm run media:fetch` to rebuild public/photos and src/lib/photo-credits.ts.
